IF (SystemException = '' AND BusinessException = '') = $'''True''' THEN
    SET LogLevel TO $'''Info'''
    SET LogMessage TO $'''Transaction successful'''
ELSE
    SET LogLevel TO $'''Warn'''
    SET LogMessage TO $'''Transaction not successful'''
END
IF IsNotEmpty(SystemException) THEN
    SET LogLevel TO $'''Error'''
    SET LogMessage TO SystemException
END
IF IsNotEmpty(BusinessException) THEN
    SET LogLevel TO $'''BusinessException'''
    SET LogMessage TO BusinessException
END
CALL Framework_LogMessage
SET SystemException TO $'''%''%'''
SET BusinessException TO $'''%''%'''
Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: TransactionNumber IncrementValue: 1
